kills.change_summary: Replace acc.balance>=_am with acc.balance>_am, disallowing collection of exactly the full balance.

kills.change_summary: Delete the locked_ = false reset at the end of nonReentrant_, leaving the contract permanently locked after first use.

kills.property: For any actor and amount, if the actor puts MinSum+ and waits past unlockTime, then a Collect that reduces c's own ETH balance must also reduce the actor's recorded Acc balance by exactly the amount received; the mutant succeeds in paying out ether but leaves the recorded Acc balance unchanged.
kills.change_summary: Remove the acc.balance subtraction and log update after the external call, so a successful Collect no longer reduces the caller's balance.

kills.property: For any admissible caller and amount, if a Collect succeeds and the caller's balance decreases, the reference contract must have required both acc.balance >= MinSum and block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime before the withdrawal; the bug allows Collect to succeed and debit when the balance is below MinSum or the funds are still locked.
kills.change_summary: Disable the balance/unlockTime guard so Collect succeeds whenever _am <= acc.balance, even if below MinSum or before unlockTime.

kills.property: For any admissible input, calling Collect can only reduce the caller's Acc.balance if that balance is at least MinSum; the mutant breaks this because it lets an account below MinSum be reduced by a Collect, so some key's Acc.balance differs after the call.
kills.change_summary: Change the threshold check from MinSum to 0, allowing Collect to proceed when the account balance is below MinSum.

kills.property: For any account and any amount, a Collect at block.timestamp == unlockTime must be rejected in the reference (returning without any balance change), whereas the mutant succeeds and reduces both the account balance and the contract balance.
kills.change_summary: Change the Collect-time check from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, allowing withdrawals exactly at the unlock time.
